#!/bin/bash
# Ansible Control Node Setup Script
# This script installs Ansible and related tools on Ubuntu

set -e

echo "==> Starting Ansible Control Node Setup"

# Function to wait for apt locks to be released
wait_for_apt() {
    local max_wait=300
    local waited=0
    while sudo fuser /var/lib/dpkg/lock-frontend >/dev/null 2>&1 || \
          sudo fuser /var/lib/apt/lists/lock >/dev/null 2>&1 || \
          sudo fuser /var/lib/dpkg/lock >/dev/null 2>&1; do
        if [ $waited -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "==> Waiting for apt locks to be released..."
        fi
        sleep 5
        waited=$((waited + 5))
        if [ $waited -ge $max_wait ]; then
            echo "==> Timeout waiting for apt locks after ${max_wait}s"
            exit 1
        fi
    done
    if [ $waited -gt 0 ]; then
        echo "==> Apt locks released after ${waited}s"
    fi
}

# Disable unattended-upgrades to prevent lock conflicts
echo "==> Stopping unattended-upgrades..."

                  self.end_headers()

        mode: "0755"

          #!/bin/bash
          set -e
          source /opt/vyatta/etc/functions/script-template
          configure

          set interfaces ethernet eth1 address '{{ router_private_cidr }}'

          set nat destination rule 10 inbound-interface name eth0
          set nat destination rule 10 protocol tcp
          set nat destination rule 10 destination port {{ app_port }}
          set nat destination rule 10 translation address {{ app_private_ip }}
          set nat destination rule 10 translation port {{ app_port }}

          set nat source rule 10 outbound-interface name eth1
          set nat source rule 10 destination address {{ app_private_ip }}
          set nat source rule 10 translation address masquerade

          set firewall ipv4 forward filter default-action drop
          set firewall ipv4 forward filter rule 5 action accept
          set firewall ipv4 forward filter rule 5 state established enable
          set firewall ipv4 forward filter rule 5 state related enable
          set firewall ipv4 forward filter rule 10 action accept
          set firewall ipv4 forward filter rule 10 inbound-interface name eth0
          set firewall ipv4 forward filter rule 10 destination address {{ app_private_ip }}
          set firewall ipv4 forward filter rule 10 destination port {{ app_port }}
          set firewall ipv4 forward filter rule 10 protocol tcp

          commit
          save
          exit

      ansible.builtin.command: bash /tmp/configure-port-forward.sh
      register: vyos_apply
      changed_when: "'commit' not in vyos_apply.stderr"

    - name: Show applied NAT destination rules
      ansible.builtin.shell: |
        source /opt/vyatta/etc/functions/script-template

      register: nat_dst
      changed_when: false

    - name: Show applied NAT source rules
      ansible.builtin.shell: |
        source /opt/vyatta/etc/functions/script-template

      register: nat_src

  hosts: client
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Confirm the app is reachable through node1's public IP on the published port
      ansible.builtin.uri:
        url: "http://{{ public_ip }}:{{ app_port }}/"
        return_content: true
      register: published_check

    - name: Assert the published app responded correctly
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - published_check.status == 200

      ansible.builtin.command: curl -s -m 3 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://{{ app_private_ip }}:{{ app_port }}/

      failed_when: false
      changed_when: false

    - name: Assert direct access to the private IP is NOT possible
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - direct_attempt.rc != 0
